Respond with a single JSON object and nothing else.
  validation tasks:   {"pattern": "...", "flags": "..."}
  extraction tasks:   {"pattern": "...", "flags": "..."}   (capture group 1 holds the answer)

turns.instruction: Capture the three-digit HTTP status code from an access log line. It follows the quoted request, e.g. '"GET / HTTP/1.1" 404 512' -> 404. Do not capture the byte count after it.
turns.user:
Task: Capture the three-digit HTTP status code from an access log line. It follows the quoted request, e.g. '"GET / HTTP/1.1" 404 512' -> 404. Do not capture the byte count after it.

Write a pattern whose first capture group holds the requested text.

Examples (input -> captured text, null means no match):
  '127.0.0.1 - "GET / HTTP/1.1" 404 512' -> '404'
  '10.0.0.1 - "POST /a HTTP/1.0" 200 1234' -> '200'
